description:
This automation remove or replace a sync SIMPSN work item to SOLVE based on the user input. 

If trigger is Remove, it will do the following:
- Remove weblink from the current SOLVE work item 
- Remove the SIMPSN_Key property from the current work item
- Remove the Sync_Status property from the current work item
- Remove weblink from the current SIMPSN linked work item
- Remove the ADVEV_Key property to the current SIMPSN linked work item
- Set the value of the Launch Issue to No for the current work item
- Add a comment to the work item

If trigger is Replace, it will do the following:
- Remove weblink to the current SOLVE work item 
- Remove the SIMPSN_Key property to the current work item
- Remove weblink to the current SIMPSN linked work item
- Remove the ADVEV_Key property to the current SIMPSN linked work item
- Remove the weblink to the SIMPSN work item from the user input
- Remove the ADVEV_Key property to the SIMPSN work item from the user input
- Remove the weblink to the SOLVE linked work item from the user input
- Remove the SIMPSN_Key property to the SOLVE linked work item from the user input
- Remove the Sync_Status property from the SOLVE linked work item from the user input
- Set the value of the Launch Issue to No for the SOLVE linked work item from the user input
- Associate the new SIMPN work item (based on user input) to the current work item
- Associate the SIMPSN_Key property to the new SOLVE work item
- Associate the Sync_Status property to the current SOLVE work item with a value of Active
- Associate the new ECM work item to the SIMPSN work item (based from user input)
- Associate the ADVEV_Key with the current SOLVE work item key to the SIMPSN work item (based from user input)
- Set the value of Launch Issue to Yes to the current work item
- Add a comment
name: SOLVE: Issue - Remove/Replace P833 SIMPSN Issue
